title: Pet Grooming Queue Management for Walk-In Salons | Esperaly

facts.fact: The Esperaly article 'Pet Grooming Queue Management' is dated 2026-10-31 and is credited to Esperaly Editorial.
The Esperaly article states a reading time of 10 minutes.
According to Esperaly, a free plan is available, and the page recommends it as the fastest way to see the join, wait, and call flow on everyday devices.
facts.quote: The [free plan](https://www.esperaly.com/auth/signup) is the fastest way to see join → wait → call on everyday devices.

facts.fact: The Esperaly article lists six example customer-facing Service types for grooming queues: nail trim/quick add-on, bath and brush, full groom by size band, puppy/intro visit, ready pickup, and enquiry/rebook/product.
facts.quote: Enquiry / rebook / product — brief questions that should not steal every open Counter from paid floor work
